title: Voltage divider schematic
prompt: Capture a schematic for a resistive voltage divider: an input terminal VIN, two resistors in series to ground, and an output terminal VOUT tapped between them. Every component pin must be connected to a net — no floating pins, no duplicate reference designators. The schematic must pass an electrical-rule check clean. Output a .vcad document with the schematic sheet in the document's schematic field.
